text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity — metering anomaly detected in embeddings pipeline. Alert: token_count_delta spike > 200% for multiple customers in the past 5m. Auto-tags: billing, metering, oncall. https://internal.redwood/alerts/2107001234 :bell:

lee (oncall-sre): acknowledged. I'm on it. pulling logs + checking recent deploys.

lee (oncall-sre): quick summary — embedding token counts jumped ~3x for a subset of requests starting at 2026-03-15T00:12Z. downstream billing window is ingesting these counts; risk of overcharge flags.

maya (billing-analytics): looping in billing analytics. can you paste sample request ids? we'll run a delta against the hourly aggregator.

lee (oncall-sre): sample ids: req_9f8a4, req_c3b2e, req_aa112. grabbing raw logs now.

lee (oncall-sre): logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T00:12:05Z token_counter: req_9f8a4 tokens=324 -> counted=1080 reason=tokenizer_delta
2026-03-15T00:12:05Z tokenizer: input="‎Hello..." normalized="Hello..." token_count=324
2026-03-15T00:12:05Z kj-embed: export_tokens=1080 backend=embed-v2 rollout=stable-2026-03-15
```

sam (eng-platform): that rollout tag `stable-2026-03-15` touched tokenizer normalization rules. I rolled that out 00:10Z. reverting now.

sam (eng-platform): Command I'm running to flip flag to legacy tokenizer:
```
# toggle ff
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_SVC" https://internal.redwood/flags/tokenizer_mode -d '{"value":"legacy"}'
```

ops-bot: feature-flag-change: tokenizer_mode set to legacy by sam at 00:20Z.

lee (oncall-sre): after flip — real-time metrics show token_count_delta back to baseline for those sample ids. good sign.

maya (billing-analytics): pausing billing-enqueue for the affected window. runbook step: pause ingestion job and queue entries for 00:10-00:25Z into a holding topic.

lee (oncall-sre): pausing pipeline now:
```
# pause ingestion
kubectl -n billing scale deployment billing-ingest --replicas=0
# cut over kafka topic
kafka-topics --alter --zookeeper zk:2181 --topic billing-input --config retention.ms=3600000
```

ops-bot: deploy: billing-ingest scaled to 0 replicas by lee at 00:27Z.

tara (support-lead): drafting customer note. Do we have an initial impact estimate? Which customers had inflated counts?

maya (billing-analytics): initial scan shows ~18 customers with >25% token uplift in that window. top affected customers: acme-co, learnly, pixelflow (list expanded in ticket BC-998). Estimated potential overcharge: ~$12k if billed as-is. We'll run recalculation after backfill.

lee (oncall-sre): immediate mitigation done: rollback FF to legacy, paused billing ingestion. Next: schedule backfill that re-processes embed requests using legacy-tokenizer counts, generate reconciliation report, and push credits if needed.

sam (eng-platform): creating a scoped hotfix to revert the normalization rule causing surrogate pairs to expand token counts. PR: https://internal.redwood/pull/3812 — will ship after quick CI smoke.

lee (oncall-sre): on-call handoff to maya for billing reconciliation. I'm going to update the incident timeline and then clear the page after stabilization. @maya you're owner for repro and billing audit.

maya (billing-analytics): taking ownership. I will: 1) run recalculation job on holding topic 2) produce per-customer delta report 3) open billing adjustments ticket per customer. ETA initial report 02:00Z.

tara (support-lead): I'll prepare the customer communication draft and hold for confirmation after you (maya) validate estimates. Draft points: what happened, what we did, credits/next steps, ETA for final reconciliation. pinging legal for compliance sign-off.

lee (oncall-sre): notes for post-incident: possible root cause — tokenizer normalization change in stable rollout mishandled RTL/hidden unicode (zero-width joiners / LTR markers) causing repetitively expanded token_id sequences. Could be edge-case in regex/normalizer.

sam (eng-platform): confirming. local repro with problematic input attached to the PR. snippet:
```
input = "‎⁦hello⁩"
legacy_count = tokenizer.legacy.count(input) # 12
new_count = tokenizer.v2.count(input) # 36
```

maya (billing-analytics): running delta against hourly-agg. quick SQL:
```
SELECT customer_id, sum(token_count_new)-sum(token_count_legacy) AS delta
FROM billing_hourly
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-15 00:00' AND '2026-03-15 01:00'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY delta DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

ops-bot: job run: pause-holdings created by maya at 00:42Z.

lee (oncall-sre): operational decision log:
- Mitigations: feature-flag revert, pause ingestion, created holding topic, blocked window for billing write, PR hotfix under review.
- Customer impact: potential overbills for ~18 customers, estimated max $12k exposure. No service downtime for API; only billing pipeline paused (customers still receive inference).
- Pager status: resolved (no further pages).

tara (support-lead): preparing templates. @maya please confirm top 5 affected customers and exact delta amounts so we don't leak internal numbers.

maya (billing-analytics): copying deltas to BC-998 (internal billing ticket). attaching CSV export for support to reference. top 5: acme-co +$4,020, learnly +$2,800, pixelflow +$1,560, autonome +$920, quanta +$480.

tara (support-lead): thanks. draft to customers will say "we detected inflated usage reporting for a limited window (00:10-00:25 UTC). We have paused billing ingestion, are recalculating usage, and will issue adjustments/credits as needed. No action required from you." Will include expected final reconciliation ETA: 48 hours.

sam (eng-platform): CI green on revert PR. plan to deploy fix to stable after postmortem and quick validation. I'll schedule a controlled rollout with canary=1% then gradually ramp.

lee (oncall-sre): closing note — incident mitigated operationally at 00:27Z when ingestion paused and ff reverted. owners: maya (billing reconciliation), sam (fix + rollout), tara (customer comms).

maya (billing-analytics): leaving the thread for now to run the backfill. I'll update BC-998 and post final reconciliation results once complete.

incident-bot: Incident 2107001234 status changed to MONITORED by lee. Link to incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incidents/2107001234.

lee (oncall-sre): thanks team :thumbsup: — follow-up items captured in the incident doc.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: postmortem-creator run in 24h to auto-populate template for incident 2107001234.
